term: Interim Measures for the Management of Generative AI Services
definition: The Interim Measures for the Management of Generative AI Services (Chinese: 生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法; pinyin: Shēngchéng shì réngōng zhìnéng fúwù guǎnlǐ zànxíng bànfǎ) are a set of measures introduced by China to regulate public-facing generative artificial intelligence within the country.
details: The measures took effect on 15 August 2023. The measures were issued by the Cyberspace Administration of China, along with six other national regulators: the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Education, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Public Security, and National Radio and Television Administration.

explainer.lead: These are Chinese measures regulating public-facing generative AI within the country, effective 15 August 2023. They matter as an early national framework governing generative AI services offered to the public.

tiers.eli5: It is China's rulebook, in force since mid-2023, for companies that offer generative AI tools to the public.
tiers.practitioner: Providers of public generative AI in China align their services with these measures, issued by the Cyberspace Administration of China together with six other national regulators. A pitfall is treating them as covering only one regulator's concerns when seven agencies jointly issued them.
tiers.paperLevel: The measures took effect on 15 August 2023 and were issued by the Cyberspace Administration of China with the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Education, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Public Security, and National Radio and Television Administration.

explainer.example: A company releasing a public generative AI service in China after 15 August 2023 would design compliance around these measures and the seven issuing regulators.
